about_the_game:
Be the strongest greatsword user in this game world. Defend your point by swinging your greatsword, and parrying attacks.

Game can be played offline. 

Story
You are retired and have you own territory. The Oranges are back! Stronger and smarter! Only you can hold them back, as you are still the strongest greatsword user in the world! Though you are pretty old right now.

Information to know
Spend Magic Ingots to temporarily empower you to your former self. You can gain this by playing the game or in-app-purchase.

Game is designed for smartphone; the UI will likely look gigantic.

The game uses PlayFab for account and leaderboard. The cloud save should be able to load into both PC version and Android version.

Disclaimer: currency is stored into your save data.

Purchase while logged in for the save to update to the cloud.
Or log in after purchasing.

Please be careful when there is a difference in Local Data and Cloud Data, confirming in choosing one will override the other.

You can play through the entire game without logging in at all.

name: Greatsword Point!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 1024 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11-compatible graphics card or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11-compatible graphics card or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows compatible sound card

short_description: Swing your greatsword and hold your point! Only you can effortlessly and endlessly fend off armies of Oranges! There is no one else up to the task!
